title: Creep

patterns.main: D - D U - U D U
patterns.chunk: D D D D D D D D

notes: Four chords, one bar each, the whole way through: G, B, C, Cm. B and Cm are your first stretch shapes. Here they are four-string versions; the full barre chords come later. Go from C to Cm by moving just two fingers. The chorus is the same chords played loud.
